code_change_check.detail: The compiled symbol body and relocation list are byte-identical to the pre-review object, so this function's own code did not change; the file digest moved because other natives and globals were added to the same translation unit.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and radare2 both recover one function at 0x00505E40 with 7 blocks and 8 edges; angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with no unresolved jumps. The candidate TextureModifier_Push is at 0x004587e0 in igi1.exe 35d92a3a, and its compiled body is byte-identical to the pre-review object.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja's prototype is void*(void* pThis); the candidate declares void* TextureModifier_Push(void* context). Both use one 32-bit pointer word in the same position.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail reads +0xBC, +0x68, the +0xDCC table, the *0xC row stride, +0xE4, and writes +0xDC; the stack is 0x00B97DA0 with count 0x00B97DF8 and cap 0x14; the published value is g_ba5060 (shifted <<8 then ORed with value+1). The candidate uses the same offsets and the namespace-scope g_b97da0/g_b97df8/g_ba5060 storage.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The candidate performs the same context accesses and the same flag/array/counter/mask writes. The compiled object contains those stores because the globals have external linkage, so codegen does not elide them.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The only retail call is Debug_Error (0x004AF7B0) on the full-stack path with the message 'Too many items in texture modifier stack!', after which the retail body never returns. The candidate calls the ported Error_Show with the same message and then hangs, preserving the non-returning path.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Accept path returns value+1 (EAX) after publishing the stack entry; reject returns pThis with the flag cleared. The candidate returns the same values on both paths.
